title: IGP-M Correction Calculator: Update a Property Purchase Price
description: Enter a BRL purchase amount and month to correct it with official Brazilian IGP-M data through the latest available month. This is not a market appraisal.
metaTitle: IGP-M Correction Calculator for Property Prices | Calculaderia
metaDescription: Correct a historical BRL property purchase amount using official Brazilian IGP-M data. See the factor, accumulated change, period, and source series.

sharePrivacy.text: The calculation runs locally with bundled public data. Shared and saved links include the amount and months entered, which anyone with the URL can view.

helpers.endpoints: The calculation includes IGP-M for both the starting and ending months, following the Brazilian Central Bank methodology.
helpers.minimum: BRL amounts are supported from July 1994; currencies used before the Real Plan are not converted.

marketNotice.title: Monetary correction, not a market appraisal
marketNotice.text: This result only corrects the original amount by accumulated IGP-M. It does not estimate a property's sale price, which depends on location, features, renovations, condition, supply, and demand.

howTo.title: How to correct an amount with IGP-M
howTo.p1: Enter the BRL amount paid and the purchase month. The calculator multiplies the official monthly IGP-M factors between the starting and ending months.
howTo.p2: The period defaults to the latest complete month in the snapshot. Choose an earlier ending month to reproduce a historical correction.

property.title: What would a property purchase amount be after IGP-M correction?
property.p1: The result expresses a historical amount after IGP-M monetary correction and can be an educational reference for comparing purchasing power between months.
property.p2: It does not mean the property would sell for that amount. A broad price index and Brazil's property market can follow very different paths.

notAppraisal.title: IGP-M is not property appreciation
notAppraisal.p1: IGP-M is a broad FGV price index. The IGP family combines 60% IPA, 30% IPC, and 10% INCC; it does not directly measure residential sale prices.
notAppraisal.p2: A market appraisal would require comparable location, area, standard, condition, and recent transaction data.

formula.title: How accumulated IGP-M between dates is calculated
formula.p1: For each month, the factor is one plus the percentage rate divided by 100. All factors are multiplied without adding percentages or rounding intermediate values.
formula.p2: Both endpoint months are included. If they are equal, one monthly rate is applied, including a negative rate.

series.title: Which IGP-M series does the calculator use?
series.p1: It uses Brazilian Central Bank SGS series 28655, identified by the Citizen Calculator methodology for IGP-M corrections consistent with FGV index-number precision.
series.p2: Series 189 publishes rounded monthly rates, so calculators based on it may show a small accumulated difference.

planReal.title: Why does correction start in July 1994?
planReal.p1: The amount field is in Brazilian reais. Older historical observations exist, but amounts originally paid in earlier currencies require a separate currency conversion.
planReal.p2: The tool starts with the Real Plan to avoid mixing cruzado, cruzeiro, and real values.

data.title: Official data through August 2026
data.p1: The snapshot contains 447 contiguous monthly series 28655 observations from June 1989 through August 2026, retrieved on August 29, 2026.
data.p2: Updates run server-side and are version controlled. The browser does not call the Central Bank or FGV while calculating.

sources.title: Official sources and methodology
sources.intro: Review the methodology, series, and limitations directly with the responsible Brazilian institutions.

related.title: Related calculators
related.intro: Explore housing, financing, and interest scenarios without confusing future assumptions with historical correction.

disclaimer.title: Important notice
disclaimer.p1: This educational tool applies monetary correction using the stated historical IGP-M series. The result is not an appraisal, report, sale price, contractual calculation, or legal, accounting, or tax advice.
disclaimer.p2: Location, property features, renovations, condition, supply, and demand may make the actual price move very differently. Consult professionals and official sources for important decisions.

q1.question: Does this show what my property is worth today?
q1.answer: No. It only shows the original amount corrected by IGP-M through the selected month. A market appraisal needs property and comparable-sale data.

q2.question: Does IGP-M measure property appreciation?
q2.answer: No. IGP-M is a broad Brazilian FGV price index, not a residential sale-price index.

q3.question: Is the purchase month included?
q3.answer: Yes. The method includes both starting and ending months. A one-month interval applies that month's rate.

q4.question: Why can the result decrease?
q4.answer: Some months have negative IGP-M. If deflation dominates the selected interval, the factor can fall below one and the nominal difference becomes negative.

q5.question: Why can another IGP-M calculator differ?
q5.answer: This tool uses higher-precision series 28655. Calculations based on rounded series 189 rates can accumulate small differences.

q6.question: What is the latest IGP-M month used?
q6.answer: The current snapshot ends in August 2026. Its date appears with the result and changes when a new official month is bundled.

q7.question: Can I correct values from before the Real Plan?
q7.answer: Not here. The input is BRL and starts in July 1994 to avoid incorrectly interpreting older currencies.

q8.question: Can I use this for a contract, lawsuit, rent, or tax?
q8.answer: Use it only as an educational reference. Contracts and legal, accounting, and tax rules can require different indices, dates, interest, and criteria.
